title: 1.1 Common Terms in Crop Production (Hard)
description: Applying definitions to scenarios and distinguishing agricultural systems by their land use

questions.question: Which contrast best distinguishes shifting from settled agriculture?
options: Temporary land use versus continuous use
Crop farming versus livestock keeping systems
questions.correctAnswer: Temporary land use versus continuous use

Toxic wild legumes were most likely detoxified by
A community farms the same plot with manure, bunds and water control. This is
Which practice best indicates a subsistence orientation?
options: Producing food mainly for the household to use
Selling most of the output at the local market each year
questions.correctAnswer: Producing food mainly for the household to use

questions.question: Which feature conflicts most with shifting cultivation?
options: Permanent soil and water conservation works
Abandonment of the land after only a few years
questions.correctAnswer: Permanent soil and water conservation works

Calling hunter-gatherers unskilled is misleading because survival required
options: Insight and detailed knowledge of nature

questions.correctAnswer: Insight and detailed knowledge of nature

questions.question: The shift from hunting to agriculture began with
options: Managing plants and animals in a deliberate way
Following wild animal herds across the different seasons
questions.correctAnswer: Managing plants and animals in a deliberate way

questions.question: Agriculture is described as deliberate because it involves
options: The cultivation of crops and rearing of animals
Hunting wild animals and collecting wild plants for food
questions.correctAnswer: The cultivation of crops and rearing of animals
